semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Daekhon Corporation specializes in motion control and machine vision systems, which are applicable in semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Daekhon Corporation provides high-performance motion control and machine vision solutions tailored for the semiconductor industry. Established in 1985, the company focuses on developing reliable systems that enhance process efficiency in semiconductor facilities.
capabilities: Motion control systems for semiconductor manufacturing
Machine vision systems for quality inspection
Engineering support and education for motion control applications

regional_presence.Korea: Daekhon Corporation supplies its technologies and solutions to semiconductor facilities in Korea.
